uccārapassāvamagga: [Uccāra+passāva+magga] (pu) CL=7 The passage where comes out urine and excrement from the body.
uccārapassāvapīḷita: [Uccāra+passāva+pīḷita] (ti) CL=7 It is afflicted by urine and excrement.
uccārapassāvaṭṭhāna: [Uccāra+passāva+ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 A place for voiding urine and excrement.
uccārapīḷita: [Uccāra+pīḷita] (ti) CL=7 It is afflicted by excrement.
uccāraṇa: [U+cara+yu] (na,thī) CL=7 (1) Rising. (2) Chanting. See - Ummasanā, Ullaṅghanā.
uccāraṇasamakāla: [Uccāraṇa+sama+kāla] (pu) CL=7 When they are chanting at the same time.
uccāraṇavatta: [Uccāraṇa+vatta] (na) CL=7 The code of conduct for reciting.
uccāraṭṭhāna: [Uccāra+ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 A place for voiding excrement, Void excrement place.
uccāreti: [U+cara+ṇe+ti] (kri) CL=7 (1) (A) It is raised, Carry up. (B) Raise and aim with his hand. (2) It chants.
uccāretuṃ: [U+cara+ṇe+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 To raise (or) To carry up.
uccārita: [U+cara+ta] (ti) CL=7 (1) Should be raised and carried up. (2) Should be recited.
uccāritakata: [Uccārita+kata] (ti) CL=7 It makes raising and carrying up. See also - Anuccāritakata.
uccāritakhagga: [Uccārita+khagga] (ti) CL=7 One has a four-edged dagger that can be raised and aimed.
uccārīyati: [U+cara+ya+te] (kamma,kri) CL=7 It should be recited. See also - Udīrayi.
uccāsadda: [Ucca(uccā)+sadda] (pu) CL=7 (1) High tone (Voice). (Ti) (2) One who has a high tone (voice).
uccāsaddamahāsadda: [Uccāsadda+mahāsadda] (ti) CL=7 It has a high tone voice and the widespread voice. Has a loud and high-tone voice.
uccāsayana: [Uccā+sayana] (na) CL=7 A high place that is (higher than 8 finger-breadth of Lord Buddha). See - Uccāsayanamahāsayana.
uccāsayanamahāsayana: [Uccāsayana+mahāsayana] (na) CL=7 A high place that is (higher than 8 finger-breadth of Lord Buddha). Not widespread and (not good) place, A high place and a noble place. Those places are (A) The bedstead is higher than 8 finger-breadth of Lord Buddha. This bedstead of a length or a width if that one is long, can not stay on, and if length and width are equal, can stay. (2) The bedstead at the base of its leg has a prey figure (such as a tiger, lion, or leopard). (3) A black carpet, if its hair is longer than  4 finger-breadth, can not stay and if shorter than 4 finger-breadth, can stay. (4) A carpet that is weaved mysteriously and makes the square pattern as the wall. (5) A white carpet made of woolen. (6) A red carpet with a floral design. It involves a carpet that has a design like a gooseberry leaf. (7) A mattress filled with silk cotton. (8) A mysterious woolen carpet with a prey figure design (such as a lion, leopard, or tiger). (9) A woolen carpet is one surface that has fur and both two surfaces have fur. (10) A woolen carpet on which two surfaces have furs or hairs. (11) A flooring sheet that was weaved with silk thread and gold thread and sewed with glittering thread. (12) A flooring that is weaved with silk thread and sewed with glittering thread. (13) A big and wide woolen carpet on which can dance 16 persons. (14) The flooring sheet has covered the back of an elephant. (15) The flooring sheet has covered the back of a horse. (16) The flooring sheet has been covered in a coach. (17) A flooring sheet is sewn with many layers of black leopard skin. (18) The good flooring sheet is sewn with a skin of a Bearcat. (19) A red carpet with a red canopied ceiling. (20) The flooring which a head part and a feet part have two red pillows. Uccāsayanamahāsayana(na) [uccāsayanamahāsayana+āsana sayana. Nokapudakhye. Vimati, 2.116.(2)uccāsayana mahāsayana+sayana. Eka does sesa. Sārattha,3.254.(3)uccāsayana mahāsayana+uccāsayana mahāsayana(sayana). Eka does sesa  Ma,ṭī,2.159. Saṃ,ṭī,2.548] (1) Staying and sleeping on the high and noble place. (1) The high and noble place, staying and sleeping in those places. See also above.
uccāvaca: [Ucca+avaca]  CL=10 (a) Big, small, big and small. (b) Great, bad, good and bad. (c) Good, bad, good and bad. (d) High, low, high and low. (e) Special, various, many, many. (f) Successive.
uccāvacasīla: [Uccāvaca+sīla] (ti) CL=7 It has high morals and low morals.
uccāvacavaṇṇa: [Uccāvaca+vaṇṇa] (pu) CL=7 Has different kinds of forms (appearance).
ucchiṭṭhamasa: [Ucchiṭṭha+maṃsa] (na) CL=7 Meat that is leftovers (or) leftovers meat.
uccākulikasavattanika: [Uccākulika+saṃvattanika] (ti) CL=7 It can be born in a noble lineage.
uccākulīnasavattanika: [Uccākulīna+saṃvattanika] (ti) CL=7 It can be born in a noble lineage.
uccāretu: [U+cara+ṇe+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 To raise (or) To carry up.
